business_summary: Airport Facilities Co., Ltd. engages in the airport related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company engages in purchase, sale, management, brokerage, leasing, and appraisal of real estate; area heating and cooling; water supply and drainage management and treatment; shared telecommunications-related business; and other operating, managing, and leasing airport-related facilities. It also offers research, design, and supervision of construction work. In addition, the company leases various facilities comprising office equipment, applied electronic machines and apparatus, vehicles, aircraft, aircraft parts, other aircraft- and space-related instruments, transportation equipment, etc. Further, it owns, rents, operates, and manages waterworks, meeting spaces, parking spaces, hotels, and restaurants and tearooms. Additionally, the company engages in the renewable energy business; collects, transports, and treats general and industrial wastes; and provides money and debt guarantee loans. Airport Facilities Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.
